database_schema.relationships_explained: A BatchJob represents a full request (e.g., a DOCX file). It contains multiple FileTasks (e.g., text chunks) which are processed individually.

api_endpoints.explained: Resets tasks stuck in Processing to Pending, and clears FPT key locks.
Returns debug info about worker threads, tasks, and API key usage.

business_rules: FPT Provider only allows one request per key at a time.
FPT API returns async URL, polling is required until audio is ready.
Dead worker threads must be pruned dynamically to avoid exceeding max_workers.
Workers lock DB for assignment only, processing API is unlocked.
features: TTS Processing Queue with robust failure recovery
Thread-safe round-robin Key rotation for FPT provider

patterns: Polling async API with early abort on HTTP 404
gotchas: Stuck thread accumulation due to zombie workers
Lazy loading session expire issues requiring fresh DB queries
